test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The reporter reported, “The US President is arriving to India this week.”

options.text: The reporter reported that the US President was arriving to India this week.
The reporter reports that the US President is arriving to India that week.
The reporter reported that the US President is arriving to India next week.
The reporter reported that the US President was arriving to India that week.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** The reporter reported that the US President was arriving to India that week.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"The US President is arriving" becomes "the US President was arriving"**
 
 
• Present continuous tense "is arriving" is converted to past continuous tense "was arriving" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **"this week" becomes "that week"**
 
 
• Time indicator "this" is changed to "that" to match the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Direct: "reported"
 
• Remains unchanged in the indirect sentence.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Indirect speech does not require quotation marks.
 
• Time indicators are adjusted to match the indirect speech context.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The reporter reported that the US President was arriving to India that week."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The reporter reported that the US President was arriving to India this week." 

 
 
• Incorrect time indicator "this week" instead of "that week".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The reporter reports that the US President is arriving to India that week." 
 
 
• Incorrect reporting verb tense "reports" instead of "reported".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "The reporter reported that the US President is arriving to India next week." 
 
 
• Incorrect time indicator "next week" instead of "that week".
